_comment: Vendored sheet_behaviour documents of materials other platforms own, for Pliego laminate layers given by material_ref (spec §5.41). Each entry is the keystone's (hyperobjects-spec) own mapping of the source card named in it, computed by scripts/qa/verify_sheet_behaviour.py --write at the keystone commit `keystone`, and drift-checked by the same script in CI (the stocks lane installs the keystone at SPEC_PIN). The kernel reads this file and never imports the keystone. Do NOT hand-edit an entry. Source cards: byte copies under scripts/qa/fixtures/sheet-behaviour/, verified 2026-10-18 by git blob id against madfam-org/fashion-cabinet main and identical to the keystone's own fixtures (tests/fixtures/sheet-behaviour/cards/fashion-cabinet). They are data from an AGPL-3.0 platform repository.

caliper_mm.basis: card physical.thickness_mm; fabric-card v1 records no test method; fashion-cabinet's preset sidecar treats card values as measured

areal_density_kg_m2.basis: card weight_gsm / 1000; fabric-card v1 records no test method; fashion-cabinet's preset sidecar treats card values as measured

E1t.basis: secant: assumed test load 500 gf/cm = 490.33 N/m (the KES-FB1 tensile maximum; FAST's 100 gf/cm would give 5× less) ÷ the card's stretch strain; the card does not record the load its stretch % was measured under; warp 1 %

E2t.basis: secant: assumed test load 500 gf/cm = 490.33 N/m (the KES-FB1 tensile maximum; FAST's 100 gf/cm would give 5× less) ÷ the card's stretch strain; the card does not record the load its stretch % was measured under; weft 2 %

G12t.basis: assumed shear rigidity 1 gf/(cm·deg) (= 56.19 N/m), an order of magnitude typical of apparel fabrics in KES-FB1; the card has no shear datum

nu12.basis: assumed ν12 = 0.3; fabric Poisson ratios vary widely and the card records none

D11.basis: bend_stiffness_class 'medium-stiff' → 0.2 gf·cm²/cm (KES-FB2 B) on the keystone's geometric ladder across ≈0.01–1 gf·cm²/cm; one class for both directions

D22.basis: bend_stiffness_class 'medium-stiff' → 0.2 gf·cm²/cm (KES-FB2 B) on the keystone's geometric ladder across ≈0.01–1 gf·cm²/cm; one class for both directions

D12.basis: isotropic plate relation ν·D with ν = 0.3

notes: contact: the card records no friction or damping; the contact block is left out rather than invented
regime: inextensible when the larger stretch is ≤ 2 %, stretchy when it is ≥ 10 % (keystone convention)
